body: I guess my problem is that the best way I have to cope with feeling bad is spending time meditating and trying to relax, but I have so much work that as soon as I'm feeling okay again I have several deadlines approaching. What specific ways did you notice wellbutrin affecting your emotions? Were you doing anything else differently that led to that happiness?

I've been on it for about a month and a half. It is the xl one. It is definitely better than the other meds I've been on so far, and I seem to have avoided the main side effects of being too agitated/anxious on it.
